messages:
Maggie: Quick sync — building a small "content signal routing" playbook for the launch + webinar. Need a table mapping inbound touchpoint -> canonical landing path + redirect policy for legacy URLs. Goals: preserve SEO equity, avoid redirect chains, and keep analytics clean. cc @Elsa @Raj

Elsa: Sounds good. Top priorities for canonicalization? webinar landing, benchmark post, docs landing?

Raj: Agreed. Also FYI: prefer 301 for permanent moves, 302 only for time-limited promos. Example nginx rewrite for promo -> permanent landing: 
```
rewrite ^/old-promo/(.*)$ /webinars/latest?src=old-promo permanent;
```
(we can change to return 302 by using "redirect" instead of "permanent")

Sam: For tracking, please append src + utm_campaign on redirects. GA4 + BigQuery requires consistent param names (src, utm_campaign). If we need measurement on a short-lived promo, tag with promo-YYYYMM.

MarketingOps: On schema: add Event schema to webinar pages (startDate, endDate, performer, offers). For benchmark posts, add Article schema + FAQ where applicable. Also ensure sitemap has correct <priority> and <lastmod> for launch pages.

Maggie: Proposed minimal CSV mapping to start (share and iterate):
```
source,utm,landing,redirect_type,owner
email_webinar,launch-w1,/webinars/redwood-inference,302,Elsa
blog_banner,launch-blog,/blog/benchmarks,301,Raj
old_promo_url,,/webinars/redwood-inference,301,MarketingOps
social_paid,launch-paid,/webinars/redwood-inference,302,MarketingOps
```
Use 302 for tracked promotional traffic we may change, 301 for permanent consolidations.

Elsa: :thumbsup: I'll take email_webinar. ETA EOD Wed. Will confirm final landing_path and utm syntax.

Raj: I'll draft the redirect rules and open a PR in infra/redirects with the nginx snippets. ETA Thu morning. I'll avoid chained rewrites and add tests.

Sam: I'll create the GA4 event spec + BigQuery mapping doc. Need final landing_path by Thu 2pm to finish events.

MarketingOps: I'll handle schema markup on the landing and double-check sitemap entries. Also will run a quick Lighthouse check after redirects go live.

Maggie: Action items summary: Elsa (email mapping), Raj (redirects PR + tests), Sam (analytics events), MarketingOps (schema + sitemap). Ping thread with PR link and GA spec. Try to avoid creating duplicate canonical tags — keep one canonical per content group.

Raj: Note — I'll include a small test snippet in PR for response codes: 
```
curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-promo/test
# expect: HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
```

Deploy Bot: redirect PR merged in infra/redirects (rev 7a3f). Deployed to staging — run sampling checks. :tada:

Maggie: Awesome. Once PR + GA spec are in, we'll run a quick post-launch audit (redirects, sitemap, schema, traffic spikes). Thanks all!
